name: sky-dull-v1
description: DIAGNOSTIC, 2026-08-20, the companion to sky-tax-v1 and the harder of the two reads. Same question - is the Aerodrome eating the Vegetable suit? - asked from the reward side instead of the price side: all four balloon rewards drop from 4 to 1, so a flight is worth taking only when the seat has nothing better. This is NOT a design proposal; it is the counterfactual that says how much of Vegetable's deficit is the sky's pull. Base is the shipped game. READ THE SAME FOUR LINES as sky-tax-v1: Vegetable's win rate (23.0%, even share 36.4%), its island deliveries (3.97), balloon moves per game (10.16), the Vegetable seat's share (0.51). CONFOUND, and it is bigger here than in the price arm: V4, V8, V16, V17 and V19 are five of Vegetable's eighteen deck cards and every one of them points at this module, so a win rate that does NOT move is the interesting result - it would mean the sky is neither helping nor hurting and five cards are pointing at nothing.
